title: Chapter 111: Petrified Giant
content:
Chapter 111: Petrified Giant

No wonder he could collapse the 1W durable light wall, it turns out there is a skill called "Mount Tai's Pressure".

Just when Wang Shuo was in a state of shock.

Brunei attacked again.

"Giant tongue attacks."

This time it went straight to Dongfang Ling.

Fang Kai and others were also intimidated because they were too close to Dongfang Ling.

But Fang Kai's level was higher, and he also changed his job to a general.

So he quickly broke free from the shackles of intimidation.

But——

It was too late.

Fang Kai and others were directly knocked away.

Dongfang Ling was not, she was directly pierced through the heart by a spike extending from the end of the giant tongue.

She was not even able to take out a defensive item.

Her health value dropped directly to 0.

Wang Shuo just sat up and saw this scene.

He couldn't believe his eyes.

In an instant.

His face changed drastically, as pale as paper.

He felt empty in his heart.

I can't tell what it was like.

Dongfang Ling's body slowly dissipated, as if she had never appeared.

Before leaving, she glanced at Wang Shuo.

Her eyes were intriguing!

After Fang Kai and others got up, they looked at each other and turned around and ran.

The attack of this golden boss was too terrible, and they were completely unable to resist it.

Just after Xie Fan and others left.

Gong Zheng also stood in front of Wang Shuo.

The protective shield in his hand was turned on.

At the same time, the "petrification" skill was activated.

[Petrification: The whole body is covered with hard petrified skin, defense +100, the body size becomes 1 times larger, the strength increases by 2 times, and the physical fitness increases by 10 times. ]

In an instant, his body size doubled, his height reached an astonishing 4.5 meters, and his body skin turned into gray rock.

Although he turned into stone, his body flexibility did not decrease.

The most important thing is that his health value reached a terrifying 22,800 points.

His original physical fitness was 210 points, which increased by 10 times, which was even more exaggerated than the silver boss.

The defense power also increased to 220 points.

It was comparable to an ordinary bronze boss.

Brunei saw the stone man in front of him with disdain in his eyes.

With a piercing long tongue, he came straight to Gong Zheng with unparalleled ferocity.

Gong Zheng did not use any skills and directly resisted the attack.

Because he had activated the body shield, there was no weakness.

Attacking any part of the body would deduct the same amount of health.

"-5000"

A huge amount of damage suddenly appeared on Gong Zheng's head.

Wang Shuo was stunned.

He realized that the damage of the attack just now was so high.

Gong Zheng also felt that he was a little arrogant at this time.

So he put the shield on his chest.

Soon, Toad Brunei launched a crazy and fierce attack.

Gong Zheng kept using skills such as blocking, damage rebound, and life feedback.

But he could not stop the fact that his health value kept decreasing.

More importantly, everyone had no means to attack Toad Brunei.

If the stalemate continued, everyone would still be swallowed.

Fang Kai and others who had fled to a distance did not leave immediately, but hid in the distance and watched.

They were so surprised to see Gong Zheng transformed into a stone man that they could not speak.

Not long after, the people of Wana Village were in despair.

From the joy of killing Cade to the complete despair at this time.

Some people inevitably felt that they were teased by fate.

Wang Shuo's head was spinning rapidly at this time.

If his head was a CPU, it should have smoked by now.

Ayub stood by and could only worry, not daring to attack close.
